description: This dataset contains prepared protein–ligand structures and benchmark results used to evaluate machine-learned interatomic potentials for label-free, quantum-mechanically informed scoring. It includes the KIN66, FEP+ R-group, HiQBind, and PLA15 benchmarks. KIN66 and PLA15 contain DFT interaction energies computed with ORCA 6 at the B97-3c, ωB97M-D3(BJ)/def2-TZVPP, and ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD levels, while the FEP+ R-group set contains scoring results and prepared structures for experimentally annotated ligands and DeepCoy-generated putative decoys. Detailed provenance, structure preparation, file organization, units, and column definitions are provided in README.txt.
citation: Cho, Ilkwon; Gokcan, Hatice; Isayev, Olexandr (2026). Benchmark datasets for label-free, quantum-mechanically informed scoring of protein-ligand complexes with machine-learned interatomic potentials. Carnegie Mellon University. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.1184/R1/33043574.v2
title: Benchmark datasets for label-free, quantum-mechanically informed scoring of protein-ligand complexes with machine-learned interatomic potentials
